**Implementation** (`/home/experimenter/experiments/runs/2026-07-26_11-43-59_claim-office-example-mapping_v4-exact-subagents_opus-5-no-thinking/src/claim-office.ts`):

- Wrapped `quotePremiumOf` in `Math.ceil` so only the final premium rounds up.

**Result**: 20 passing, 31 todo.

**Why this is minimal**: The surcharge is unconditional, so no customer field, no branching, no conditional on quote index — just one additional term computed from the already-existing `policyBasePremiumOf`. It slots in beside the existing `policySurchargeOf` term without restructuring anything. `Math.ceil` was needed because the 7-rune case (197.5) and single-rune case (32.5) now produce fractions; it is applied once at the outermost point so intermediate amounts stay fractional, which is the smallest change that satisfies both. The `Customer` type was left untouched as instructed.
